title: Eval result
description: One eval run, written to the private store as eval/results/<id>.json (design part 17.5). It records what a later person or run needs to tell a real change from a different setup: the plugin version and commit, the schema versions, the harness profiles, the policy hash, the scenario set and the seed. A run is the baseline for the regression gate only when its settings match.

id.description: EV-<UTC date and time>-<first six hex digits of the settings hash>.

schema_versions.description: The current schema_version of each data format, by schema ID.

harness.description: The adapter profiles the run drove. A live run adds the harness, model and effort per role.

policy_hash.description: The hash of the effective policy.json (design part 16.6).

policy_source.description: file: the project's policy.json. defaults: none was found, so the defaults with a stand-in project ID.

settings.description: What must match for two runs to be comparable. settings_hash is taken over mode, seed and profiles.

scenario_set.description: The version of the scenarios run: a hash of their content. It changes when a scenario, a grader setting or a label does.

profile.description: The adapter profile, or none for a scenario that drives no harness.

result.description: How the scenario ended: pass, fail (a grader failed), error (the scenario or the runner broke), or not-applicable (never counted as a pass). Version 3 (HITLD-82) renamed status to result, not_applicable to not-applicable and piece to suite; an older result or baseline is read in the new names.

path.description: The value the grader looked at, where it has one (added in version 2).

expected.description: What the grader wanted, where it has one. Over 2,000 characters it is cut to a string and expected_truncated is true (added in version 2).

actual.description: What the grader found, where it has one. Over 2,000 characters it is cut to a string and actual_truncated is true (added in version 2).

transcript.description: The store key of the transcript, kept for every scenario that did not pass.

categories.description: The mean score of each category's applicable scenarios.

checkout.description: The checkout the suite ran in: its commit and whether its working tree had changes (tracked or untracked files; ignored ones left out). Null when it was not a git checkout. A run is accepted as the baseline only when its commit is on the main branch and its tree was clean (design part 17.9). Absent in runs recorded before this was kept, which cannot be accepted. A stored baseline and the committed one never have it.

accepted.description: Present only on a baseline: who accepted this run as the baseline, and when (added in version 2). The stored run itself never has it. The baseline committed in evals/baselines/ is the same document in its committed form: grader messages empty, no reasons, wall time 0, no transcript keys, no commit, no gate verdict.

gate.description: The regression gate's verdict against the baseline, when there was one.
